mentions.name: RunCanary
mentions.description: This tool provides adversarial companions to coding agents that stress-test agents, software, and code, helping uncover blind spots, broken functionality, and security issues in a left-shift mode before problems surface later.
mentions.problem: Blind spots, broken functionality, and security issues in agent-generated code and software go undetected until late in development.
mentions.audience: Blind spots, broken functionality, and security issues in agent-generated code and software go undetected until late in development.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building Adversarial companions to coding agents that help break agents, software and code. Helps uncover blind spots and broken functionalities, security issues etc in a left-shift mode.

Check us out at https://www.runcanary.ai
